discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.10.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.10/cis_2.3.10.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Member Server only (from the upstream task name).

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.10.3 | PATCH | Ensure Network access Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares is set to Enabled MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win25cis_rule_2_3_10_3
    - not prelim_win25cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.10.3
    - patch
    - sam
    - NIST800-171_3.1.7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_10
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa
    name: RestrictAnonymous
    data: 1
    type: dword
